en.description:
Kitty on the Run is a fast-paced Apple Watch platform adventure starring an energetic orange tabby.

Tap for a short jump, or press and hold to leap higher and farther. Turn the Digital Crown for a regular jump. Race across cat towers and rooftops, explore basements, choose upper and lower paths, and avoid lakes, dogs, rolling yarn balls, and other surprises.

The adventure changes as your score grows. Climb foggy mountains with spring shoes, race downhill, cross gaps on jumping fish, and carefully time your jumps through a sky route filled with flying fish.

Features:
• Made for Apple Watch
• Short-tap and long-press jump controls
• Digital Crown jump control
• Randomized platforms and obstacles
• Rooftops, basements, lakes, mountains, clouds, and multiple routes
• Sunrise, morning, afternoon, sunset, and night backgrounds
• Local top-three scoreboard
• No ads, accounts, tracking, or in-app purchases

How far can your orange tabby run?
en.releaseNotes:
The adventure runs more smoothly in version 1.1!
• Fixed an issue that could stop the sky elevator before it started moving.
• Jumping fish now descend when the cat waits on them, so time your next jump before reaching the water.
• Added a nervous cat reaction while riding a sinking fish.
